title: Customizing Automated Email Templates and Member Notifications

sections.heading: Email Templates Overview
sections.content: Brilliant Directories sends automated transactional emails for member registration, welcome messages, payment receipts, password resets, and lead inquiries. All emails are customizable under Emails > Email Templates.

sections.heading: Editing Welcome Email
sections.content:
To edit the welcome email:
1. Go to Emails > Email Templates.
2. Search for 'welcome-member' in the template search bar.
3. Click 'Customize'.
4. Use the rich text WYSIWYG editor to adjust text, logo, and layout.
5. Use shortcodes such as %user_name%, %website_name%, and %login_url%.
6. Click 'Save Changes'.

full_text:
Email Templates Overview
Brilliant Directories sends automated transactional emails for member registration, welcome messages, payment receipts, password resets, and lead inquiries. All emails are customizable under Emails > Email Templates.

Editing Welcome Email
To edit the welcome email:
1. Go to Emails > Email Templates.
2. Search for 'welcome-member' in the template search bar.
3. Click 'Customize'.
4. Use the rich text WYSIWYG editor to adjust text, logo, and layout.
5. Use shortcodes such as %user_name%, %website_name%, and %login_url%.
6. Click 'Save Changes'.
